grammarFocus: 比较结构；百分比与数量表达；there was / were；趋势动词。 Teach the new rule in Chinese, then provide at least 8 distinct grammar questions in new sentences. Distinguish a newly taught form from revision. title: The Library's New Map: Comparing Old and New Access
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，完成10个问题。短文和问题均为英文，解释为中文。所有内容为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思试题。请先通读全文，再作答。答案必须来自原文。
passage:
A. The Westside Library is changing. Last year, the library had one main entrance and a single information desk. Today, it has three entrances and two help desks. The library is now more open and easier to enter. In the past, visitors walked to the back of the building to find the catalog. Now, a digital map stands near the front door. The map is more helpful than the old paper list. It shows every shelf and every room. If you compare the old building with the new one, you can see that the library wants to make things simple for visitors. The new entrances also mean that people do not have to walk through the whole building just to ask a question. This saves time, especially for people who visit the library for only a few minutes.

B. The number of visitors is growing. In January, about 1,200 people visited the library each week. In June, the number was 1,800. That is a 50 percent increase. The library also has more computers now. There were 10 computers before. There are 25 computers today. More people use the computers than before. The quiet room is smaller than the old reading room, but it is quieter. Many students study there. The staff say that students often come after school and stay for several hours. The extra computers help people who do not have a computer at home. They can check email, look for jobs, or do school work.

C. The library staff compared two plans. Plan A was cheaper, but Plan B was better for visitors. The staff chose Plan B. The new design has fewer shelves and more open space. There are more chairs and tables now. The children's area is larger than before. It has a new story corner. The library also added a small café. The café is busier in the morning than in the afternoon. The open space makes it easier for parents to watch their children while they read. The café gives visitors a place to rest and talk. It also sells drinks and simple snacks at low prices.

D. Not everything is perfect. The library has fewer parking spaces now. There were 40 spaces before. There are 30 spaces today. Some drivers are not happy. Also, the new map is sometimes difficult for older visitors. The staff now offers a short class every Saturday. The class teaches visitors how to use the digital map. The library plans to add more signs next year. The number of visitors continues to rise. The staff hope that the signs and the class will help everyone feel welcome. They also want to hear visitors' ideas, so they put a suggestion box near the front desk.

grammar.title: 比较结构；百分比与数量表达；there was / were；趋势动词
grammar.explanation: 本课学习四种表达。第一，比较结构：用 -er/more + than 比较两者，如 smaller than, more helpful than。第二，百分比与数量：50 percent increase 表示增长百分之五十；数字前用 about 表示大约。第三，there was / there were：there was 后接单数名词，there were 后接复数名词，如 There were 10 computers before. 第四，趋势动词：rise（上升）、grow（增长）、increase（增加）描述变化。注意：there was/were 是复习，比较结构是本课新重点。

questions.prompt: The new room is ______ than the old room.
questions.explanation: 比较两者用比较级 bigger，than 前用比较级。
questions.evidence: The quiet room is smaller than the old reading room, but it is quieter.

questions.prompt: This map is ______ than the paper list.
questions.explanation: 多音节形容词 helpful 的比较级用 more helpful。
questions.evidence: The map is more helpful than the old paper list.

questions.prompt: There ______ 25 computers in the library today.
questions.explanation: today 表示现在，25 computers 是复数，用 there are。
before 表示过去，40 spaces 是复数，用 there were。
is 后接现在分词 rising，表示正在上升。
questions.evidence: The number of visitors continues to rise.

questions.prompt: The library has ______ shelves than before.
questions.explanation: shelves 是可数名词复数，比较级用 fewer。
questions.evidence: The new design has fewer shelves and more open space.

questions.prompt: The children's area is ______ than before.
questions.explanation: 单音节形容词 large 的比较级是 larger。
questions.evidence: The children's area is larger than before.

questions.prompt: There ______ a small café in the library now.
questions.explanation: a small café 是单数，现在时用 there is。
questions.evidence: The library also added a small café.
